description: TY2027: married filing jointly, wages $180,000, two qualifying children. Standard deduction $33,200 → taxable income $146,800 (≥ $100,000, so the rate schedule): $2,560 + 12% × ($104,050 − $25,600) = $9,414 + 22% × ($146,800 − $104,050) = $9,405 → $21,379. Child tax credit $2,300 per child (§ 3.05(1)) = $4,600, under the $400,000 phase-out → net tax $16,779.
